name: Oil, Gas, & Other Regulated Wells: Beginning 1860
attribution: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation, Division of Mineral Resources
description: Information on oil, gas, storage, solution salt, stratigraphic, and geothermal wells in New York State

columns.name: API Well Number
columns.description: Unique 14-digit well identification number designed by the American Petroleum Institute (API) and referred to as the API number

columns.name: County Code
columns.description:
Three-digit code identifying the county where the surface of the well is
located; this code also appears as the third through fifth digits of the
API number. A list of the county codes and numbers appears in the attached Data Dictionary document.
(Note: The data does not display any preceding zeroes.)

columns.name: API Hole Number
columns.description:
Five-digit code identifying the well; this code also appears as the sixth through tenth digits of the API number.

(Note: The data does not display any preceding zeroes.)

columns.name: Sidetrack
columns.description:
Two-digit code identifying any secondary wellbore, called a sidetrack, which is drilled out of and away from the original wellbore; this code also appears as the eleventh and twelfth digits of the API number.

(Note: The data does not display any preceding zeroes.)

columns.name: Completion
columns.description:
Two-digit code identifying the number of operations, known as completions, which have occurred in a given wellbore to allow oil/gas to enter the wellbore; this code also appears as the thirteenth and fourteenth digits of the API number. 

(Note: The data does not display any preceding zeroes.)

columns.name: Well Name
columns.description: Name of the well as designated on the permit application; typically the well name is based on the lease or unit name.

columns.name: Company Name
columns.description: Well owner/operator

columns.name: Operator Number
columns.description: Unique ID number assigned to each well owner/operator

Map Symbol

columns.description: Date current well status was assigned

columns.name: Permit Application Date
columns.description: Date permit application was received

columns.name: Permit Issued Date
columns.description: Date permit was issued/approved

columns.name: Date Spudded
columns.description: Date drilling began

columns.name: Date of Total Depth
columns.description: Date wellbore was drilled to its endpoint, or total depth

columns.name: Date Well Completed
columns.description: Date on which all activities and methods of preparing the well for production or other purposes (e.g., disposal, storage, etc.) were completed, making the well fully operational

columns.name: Date Well Plugged
columns.description: Date of completed plugging operations whereby the well was closed permanently with cement plugs

columns.name: Date Well Confidentiality Ends
columns.description: Date confidential status ends/ended

columns.name: Confidentiality Code
Town
columns.description: Town where the surface location of the well resides

columns.name: Quad
columns.description: United States Geological Survey 7.5-minute quadrangle/topographic map of the location where the well resides

columns.name: Quad Section
columns.description: Letter designation (A-I) of the specific section of the United States Geological Survey quadrangle map where the surface location of the well resides

columns.name: Producing Field
columns.description: Name of the producing field or geographically local area underlain by an accumulation, pool or group of pools of oil/gas

columns.name: Producing Formation
columns.description: Name of the geologic formation from which the well is producing oil, gas, or brine

columns.name: Financial Security
columns.description:
Financial security codes:

 TRUE – The well is subject to financial security requirements; 
FALSE – The well is not subject to financial security requirements 

Financial security is required for all wells drilled after June 5, 1973 to guarantee that funds will be available in the future for ultimate well plugging and surface restoration.

columns.name: Slant
columns.description: Orientation of wellbore (Vertical/Horizontal/Directional)

columns.name: County
columns.description: County where the surface of the well is located

columns.name: Region
columns.description: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation region where the surface of the well is located. A map of NYSDEC regions can be found on NYSDEC’s website at: http://www.dec.ny.gov/about/50230.html.

columns.name: State Lease
Proposed Depth, ft
columns.description: Depth (feet) specified on permit application

columns.name: Surface Longitude
columns.description: Longitude (decimal degrees) of surface location of the well

columns.name: Surface Latitude
columns.description: Latitude (decimal degrees) of surface location of the well

columns.name: Bottom Hole Longitude
columns.description: Longitude (decimal degrees) of bottom hole, or lowest/deepest location of the wellbore

columns.name: Bottom Hole Latitude
columns.description: Latitude (decimal degrees) of bottom hole, or lowest/deepest location of the wellbore

columns.name: True Vertical Depth, ft
columns.description: Total vertical distance (feet) between the bottom hole, or lowest/deepest location of the wellbore and the surface

columns.name: Measured Depth, ft
columns.description: Total measured length (feet) of the wellbore

columns.name: Kickoff, ft
columns.description: Depth (feet) in a vertical wellbore at which a deviated or slanted wellbore is started to allow for directional drilling

columns.name: Drilled Depth, ft
columns.description: Total measured length (feet) of the wellbore in a vertical well or the measured length (feet) of the wellbore from the kickoff point to the bottom hole, or total depth, of the wellbore

columns.name: Elevation, ft
columns.description: Elevation (feet) above sea level at the surface location of the well

columns.name: Original Well Type
Permit Fee
columns.description:
Total dollar amount charged for a well permit, including a fee based on depth (ft.) of the wellbore and a mandatory $100 fee to be credited to the oil and gas account.

Permit fees can be calculated at: http://www.dec.ny.gov/energy/1779.html

columns.name: Objective Formation
columns.description: Geologic formation targeted for production as designated on the permit application

columns.name: Depth Fee
columns.description: Dollar amount charged as part of the permit fee, based on depth (ft.) of the wellbore

columns.name: Spacing
columns.description: Indicates whether the spacing unit associated with the well conforms to statewide spacing under Title 5 of Article 23 of the Environmental Conservation Law, whether the unit is non-conforming, or whether the unit is exempt.
